facts.text: In the constitution approved May 5, 1985, Big Lagoon Rancheria names the General Council as its governing body and delegates business to an elected Business Council.

source.title: Constitution of the Big Lagoon Rancheria
source.publisher: Big Lagoon Rancheria via Native American Rights Fund / National Indian Law Library

facts.text: Big Lagoon Rancheria’s 1985 constitution links its territorial provisions to Rancheria boundaries established under federal authority on July 10, 1918.

source.title: Constitution of the Big Lagoon Rancheria
source.publisher: Big Lagoon Rancheria via Native American Rights Fund / National Indian Law Library

facts.text: Two Feathers Native American Family Services says it became a tribal nonprofit chartered under Big Lagoon Rancheria in 2002.

source.title: About Two Feathers
source.publisher: Two Feathers Native American Family Services

facts.text: In its May 2025 ACORN review, Two Feathers reported that youth paddled redwood canoes from Big Lagoon Rancheria during a May 4 gathering at Big Lagoon.

source.title: 2025 ACORN Youth Wellness Program: Year in Review
source.publisher: Two Feathers Native American Family Services

facts.evidence: Youth paddled redwood canoes from Big Lagoon Rancheria
